arxiv-2202-07596.title: A General Framework for Modelling Conditional Reasoning - Preliminary Report
arxiv-2202-07596.creator: Giovanni Casini, Umberto Straccia
arxiv-2202-07596.description: Abstract We introduce and investigate here a formalisation for conditionals that allows the definition of a broad class of reasoning systems. This framework covers the most popular kinds of conditional reasoning in logic-based KR: the semantics we propose is appropriate for a structural analysis of those conditionals that do not satisfy closure properties associated to classical logics.

arxiv-2307-13438.title: Local density of states above a disk — geometrical vs. thermal boundary conditions
arxiv-2307-13438.creator: Svend-Age Biehs, Achim Kittel, Zhenghua An
arxiv-2307-13438.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Svend-Age Biehs, Achim Kittel, Zhenghua An. We analytically calculate the contribution to the local density of states due to thermal sources in a disk-like patch within the framework of fluctuational electrodynamics. We further introduce a wavevector cutoff method to approximate this contribution. We compare the results obtained with the source and cutoff method with the numerical exact LDOS above a metal disk attained by SCUFF-EM calculations.

arxiv-2308-01056.title: Impact of the noise knowledge uncertainty for the science exploitation of cosmological and astrophysical stochastic gravitational wave background with LISA
arxiv-2308-01056.creator: Martina Muratore, Jonathan Gair, Lorenzo Speri
arxiv-2308-01056.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Martina Muratore, Jonathan Gair, Lorenzo Speri. This paper investigates the impact of a lack of knowledge of the instrumental noise on the characterisation of stochastic gravitational wave backgrounds with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We focus on constraints on modelled backgrounds that represent the possible backgrounds from the mergers of binary black holes of stellar origin, from primordial black hole generation, from non-standard inflation, and from sound wave production during cosmic fluid phase transitions.

arxiv-2405-04578.title: Stochastic star formation and the abundance of z > 10 z>10 UV-bright galaxies
arxiv-2405-04578.creator: Andrey Kravtsov, Vasily Belokurov
arxiv-2405-04578.description: Abstract We use a well-motivated galaxy formation framework to predict stellar masses, star formation rates (SFR), and ultraviolet (UV) luminosities of galaxy populations at redshifts z ∈ 5 − 16 z\in 5-16 , taking into account stochasticity of SFR in a controlled manner.

arxiv-2502-04165.title: Continuously varying critical exponents in an exactly solvable long-range cluster XY model
arxiv-2502-04165.creator: Tian-Cheng Yi, Chengxiang Ding, Maoxin Liu, Liangsheng Li, Wen-Long You
arxiv-2502-04165.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tian-Cheng Yi, Chengxiang Ding, Maoxin Liu, Liangsheng Li, Wen-Long You. We investigate a generalized antiferromagnetic cluster XY model in a transverse magnetic field, where long-range interactions decay algebraically with distance. This model can be exactly solvable within a free fermion framework. By analyzing the gap, we explicitly derive the critical exponents ν \nu and z z , finding that the relationship ν ​ z = 1 \nu z=1 still holds.

arxiv-2504-03795.title: Electromagnetic Helicity in Twisted Cavity Resonators
arxiv-2504-03795.creator: E. C. I. Paterson, J. Bourhill, M. E. Tobar, M. Goryachev
arxiv-2504-03795.description: Abstract Through left- or right-handed twisting, we investigate the impact of mirror-asymmetry (chirality) of the conducting boundary conditions of an equilaterial triangular cross-section electromagnetic resonator. We observe the generation of eigenmodes with non-zero electromagnetic helicity as a result of the coupling of near degenerate TE 11(p+1) and TM 11p modes.

arxiv-2504-07632.title: A Stochastic Ekman–Stokes Model for Coupled Ocean–Wave–Atmosphere Dynamics
arxiv-2504-07632.creator: Long Li 1,2, Etienne Mémin 1,2, Bertrand Chapron 1,3
arxiv-2504-07632.description: Abstract Accurate representation of atmosphere-ocean boundary layers, including the interplay of turbulence, surface waves, and air–sea fluxes, remains a challenge in geophysical fluid dynamics, particularly for climate simulations. This study introduces a stochastic coupled Ekman–Stokes model (SCESM) developed within the physically consistent Location Uncertainty framework, explicitly incorporating random turbulent fluctuations and surface wave effects.

arxiv-2508-04956.title: MENDR: Manifold Explainable Neural Data Representations
arxiv-2508-04956.creator: Matthew Chen, Micky Nnamdi, Justin Shao, Andrew Hornback, Hongyun Huang, Ben Tamo, Yishan Zhong, Benoit Marteau, Wenqi Shi, May Dongmei Wang
arxiv-2508-04956.description: Abstract Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) signals have recently demonstrated success in learning generalized representations of EEGs, outperforming specialized models in various downstream tasks. However, many of these models lack transparency in their pretraining dynamics and offer limited insight into how well EEG information is preserved within their embeddings.

arxiv-2510-03006.title: Not every day is a sunny day: Synthetic cloud injection for deep land cover segmentation robustness evaluation across data sources
arxiv-2510-03006.creator: Sara Mobsite, Renaud Hostache, Laure Berti-Équille, Emmanuel Roux, Joris Guérin
arxiv-2510-03006.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sara Mobsite, Renaud Hostache, Laure Berti-Équille, Emmanuel Roux, Joris Guérin. Supervised deep learning for land cover semantic segmentation (LCS) relies on labeled satellite data. However, most existing Sentinel-2 datasets are cloud-free, which limits their usefulness in tropical regions where clouds are common. To properly evaluate the extent of this problem, we developed a cloud injection algorithm that simulates realistic cloud cover, allowing us to test how Sentinel-1 radar data can fill in the gaps caused by cloud-obstructed optical imagery.

arxiv-2511-17107.title: A Robust GPU-Accelerated Kernel Compensation Solver with Novel Discretization for Photonic Crystals in Pseudochiral Media This work was supported by Strategic Priority Research Program of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (XDB0640000, XDB0640300, XDB0620203, XDA0480504), National Key Research and Deve
arxiv-2511-17107.creator: Chenhao Jin, Hehu Xie
arxiv-2511-17107.description: Abstract This paper develops a robust solver for the Maxwell eigenproblem in 3D photonic crystals (PCs) with pseudochiral media. The solver employs the Kernel Compensation technique under the framework of Yee’s scheme to eliminate null space and enable matrix-free, GPU-accelerated operations via 3D discrete Fourier transform (DFT).

pmc-10583968.title: Optical quality of the cornea after Descemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty surgery: early results from Türkiye
pmc-10583968.creator: Emine Esra Karaca, Feyza Dicle Işık, Özlem Evren Kemer
pmc-10583968.description: BackgroundDescemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty (DMEK) is increasingly favored in the treatment of endothelial dysfunction due to its benefits, which include swift visual rehabilitation and recovery, a relatively low rejection rate, and superior refractive stability. In this study, we examined alterations in corneal clarity among patients who underwent DMEK and correlated these densitometry findings with other optical parameters of corneal topography.

pmc-11471475.title: Assessing of sugar beet Seed adaptation under salt and drought stress conditions with coating technology based on Fuzzy inference system
pmc-11471475.creator: Ehsan Neamatollahi, Mahboobeh Mohammadi, Reza Tavakkol Afshari
pmc-11471475.description: Sustainability in crop production is highly dependent on favorable indicators of germination and seedling establishment. In this research seed coating different treatments data prepared and membership function defined in fuzzy inference system then used rule editor tool for determining parameters weight for achieved the best coating treatment in salinity and drought stress conditions.

pmc-11509952.title: Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, and Altered Lymphocyte E-NTPDase Are Implicated in Acute Dyslipidemia in Rats: Protective Role of Arbutin
pmc-11509952.creator: Reem S. Alruhaimi, Omnia E. Hussein, Sulaiman M. Alnasser, Mousa O. Germoush, Meshal Alotaibi, Emad H. M. Hassanein, Mohamed El Mohtadi, Ayman M. Mahmoud
pmc-11509952.description: Background/Objectives: Dyslipidemia is frequently linked to various disorders, and its clinical relevance is now recognized. The role of inflammation and oxidative stress (OS) in dyslipidemia has been acknowledged. This study assessed the potential of arbutin (ARB) to prevent dyslipidemia and its associated OS and inflammation in rats with acute hyperlipidemia.

pmc-11655927.description: Background165Er (t1/2 = 10.4 h, Ex-ray = 47.1 keV (59.4%) and 54.3 keV (14.3%)) is a promising radionuclide suitable for targeted Auger electron therapy of cancer. 165Er can be produced at a relatively low cost, high yield, and high purity using small medical cyclotrons.

pmc-12427637.title: Two-Dimensional GC–ToFMS Analysis of Volatile Organic Compounds in Fermented Camel Milk (Shubat)
pmc-12427637.creator: Sagyman Zhadyra, Fei Tao, Ping Xu, Shahab A Shamsi, Francesca Buiarelli
pmc-12427637.description: Shubat, a traditional fermented camel milk from Kazakhstan, is renowned for its unique flavor and nutritional properties, though its volatile compound profile remains poorly characterized. In this study, headspace solid-phase microextraction coupled with comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography–time-of-flight mass spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC×GC–ToFMS) was employed to qualitatively identify and semi-quantitatively analyze volatile metabolites in seven Shubat samples collected from four regions of Kazakhstan.

pmc-12438826.title: Which factors predict the improvement perception after a Single-Session Intervention on frontline professionals during a crisis situation?
pmc-12438826.creator: A. L. D. S. Ache, B. B. Montezano, B. P. Mosqueiro, M. A. Caldieraro, L. Spanemberg, G. A. Salum, M. P. Fleck
pmc-12438826.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionThe COVID-19 pandemic set up a global health crisis, with an impact on the daily lives of the population. The effectiveness and importance of Single-Session Interventions (SSI), have increasingly been demonstrated, which also found expression during the Pandemic and remote care and has shown a significant impact in reducing symptoms, reducing relapses and hospitalizations, increasing positive attitudes, improving treatment adherence, and reducing the length of hospital stay for various mental disorders.

pmc-12628003.creator: Xiao Li, Jilong Liu, Dong Yang, Duo Wang, Qiulin Yue, Song Zhang, Jing Xu, Xingtao Jiang, Qun Su, Lei Sun, Baojun Li, Kunlun Li, Le Su, Lin Zhao

pmc-12648122.description: BackgroundGastric cancer is a serious health issue both globally and in Kazakhstan. Worldwide, gastric cancer ranks fifth in incidence, with the highest rates reported in East Asia, the Andes of South America, and Eastern Europe, while the lowest rates are reported in North America, Northern Europe, Africa, and Southeast Asia. Over 70% of the cases occur in resource-limited countries.

pmc-13226844.title: Temporal Analysis of Patients Eligible for Randomized Controlled Trials in Total Hip Arthroplasty
pmc-13226844.creator: Brynn P. Charron, Ethan Pieterman, Brent Charron, Elia Arbana, Brent A. Lanting
pmc-13226844.description: BackgroundThere has been a shift in the demographics of patients undergoing elective lower extremity joint arthroplasties in recent years. pmc-13365451.creator: Adam Bartok, László Csanády
pmc-13365451.description: The Ca2+ permeable cation channel TRPM2 is expressed in neurons of the hypothalamic thermoregulatory center, and contributes to body temperature regulation.
